For the default 64 KiB\n141\t\t\t// block this is 2 * 5.25 MiB = 10.5 MiB.\n142\t\t\tcfg.MultipartSize = 2 * canaryMultipartPartSize(crypto.DefaultBlockSize)\n143\t\t}\n144\t\n145\t\tinstanceID := cfg.Bucket,\n159\t\t\tmek:               cfg.MEK,\n160\t\t\tblockSize:         cfg.BlockSize,\n161\t\t\tinstanceID:        instanceID,\n162\t\t\tinterval:          cfg.Interval,\n163\t\t\tcanarySize:        cfg.CanarySize,\n164\t\t\tmaxRetries:        cfg.MaxRetries,\n165\t\t\tretryDelay:        cfg.RetryDelay,\n166\t\t\tmultipartInterval: cfg.MultipartInterval,\n167\t\t\tmultipartSize: StatusUnknown,\n172\t\t\t\tMultipartHealthy: StatusUnknown,\n173\t\t\t\tInstanceID:       instanceID,\n174\t\t\t},\n175\t\t}\n176\t}\n177\t\n178\t// Start begins the periodic canary checks.\n179\t// It runs an initial check immediately, then periodically.\n180\tfunc (m *Monitor) Start(ctx context.Context) {\n181\t\tgo func() {\n182\t\t\tdefer close(m.doneCh)\n183\t\n184\t\t\t// Initial checks\n185\t\t\tm.runCheck(ctx)\n186\t\t\tm.runMultipartCheck(ctx)\n187\t\n188\t\t\tticker := time.NewTicker(m.interval)\n189\t\t\tmultipartTicker := time.NewTicker(m.multipartInterval)\n190\t\t\tdefer ticker.Stop()\n191\t\t\tdefer multipartTicker.Stop()\n192\t\n193\t\t\tfor {\n194\t\t\t\tselect {\n195\t\t\t\tcase <-multipartTicker.C:\n202\t\t\t\t\tm.runMultipartCheck(ctx)\n203\t\t\t\t}\n204\t\t\t}\n205\t\t}()\n206\t}\n207\t\n208\t// Stop stops the canary monitor.\n209\tfunc (m *Monitor) Stop() {\n210\t\tclose(m.stopCh)\n211\t\t<-m.doneCh\n212\t}\n213\t\n214\t// runCheck performs a single canary check with retries.\n215\tfunc (m *Monitor) runCheck(ctx context.Context) {\n216\t\tvar lastErr error\n217\t\n218\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.IncCanaryChecks()\n219\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.SetCanaryLastCheck(time.Now())\n220\t\n221\t\tfor attempt := 0; attempt < m.maxRetries; attempt++ {\n222\t\t\tif attempt > 0 {\n223\t\t\t\tselect {\n224\t\t\t\tcase <-time.After(m.retryDelay):\n225\t\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n226\t\t\t\t\treturn\n227\t\t\t\t}\n228\t\t\t}\n229\t\n230\t\t\tresult, time.Duration\n248\t\tvar lastAttemptOp string\n249\t\n250\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.IncMultipartCanaryChecks()\n251\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.SetMultipartCanaryLastCheck(time.Now())\n252\t\n253\t\tfor attempt := 0; attempt < m.maxRetries; err.Error()\n277\t\t\tif strings.Contains(errStr, \"upload\") || strings.Contains(errStr, \"part\") {\n278\t\t\t\tlastAttemptOp = \"upload\"\n279\t\t\t} else if strings.Contains(errStr, \"download\") || strings.Contains(errStr, \"decrypt\") || strings.Contains(errStr, \"verify\") {\n280\t\t\t\tlastAttemptOp = \"verify\"\n281\t\t\t} else {\n282\t\t\t\t// Default to upload if we can't determine\n283\t\t\t\tlastAttemptOp = \"upload\"\n284\t\t\t}\n285\t\t}\n286\t\n287\t\t// Record failure metric for the last attempt\n288\t\tif lastAttemptOp != \"\" && lastAttemptDuration > 0 lastAttemptDuration)\n290\t\t}\n291\t\n292\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.IncMultipartCanaryFailures()\n293\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.SetMultipartCanaryLastError(lastErr.Error())\n294\t\tmetrics.DefaultMetrics.SetMultipartCanaryHealthy(false)\n295\t\tm.updateMultipartStateFailure(lastErr)\n296\t}\n297\t\n298\t// m.blockSize, plaintextSHA)\n339\t\tif err != nil {\n340\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create header: %w\", err)\n341\t\t}\n342\t\n343\t\theaderBytes, err := header.Encode()\n344\t\tif err != nil {\n345\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to encode header: %w\", err)\n346\t\t}\n347\t\n348\t\t// Encrypt\n349\t\tencryptor, err := crypto.NewEncryptor(dek, iv, m.blockSize)\n350\t\tif err != nil {\n351\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create encryptor: %w\", err)\n352\t\t}\n353\t\n354\t\tencrypted, hmacTable, err := encryptor.Encrypt(canaryContent)\n355\t\tif err != nil {\n356\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to encrypt: %w\", err)\n357\t\t}\n358\t\n359\t\t// Build envelope\n360\t\tenvelope := make([]byte, 0, len(headerBytes)+len(encrypted)+len(hmacTable))\n361\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, headerBytes...)\n362\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, encrypted...)\n363\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, hmacTable...)\n364\t\n365\t\t// Compute ETag\n366\t\tetag := backend.ComputeETag(canaryContent)\n367\t\n368\t\t// Build metadata\n369\t\tmeta := (&backend.ARMORMetadata{\n370\t\t\tVersion:       1,\n371\t\t\tBlockSize:     m.blockSize,\n372\t\t\tPlaintextSize: int64(len(canaryContent)),\n373\t\t\tContentType:   \"application/octet-stream\",\n374\t\t\tIV:            iv,\n375\t\t\tWrappedDEK: Cloudflare)\n381\t\tuploadStart := time.Now()\n382\t\tif err := m.backend.Put(ctx, m.bucket, key, bytes.NewReader(envelope), int64(len(envelope)), meta); err != nil {\n383\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to upload canary: %w\", err)\n384\t\t}\n385\t\tresult.UploadLatencyMs = time.Since(uploadStart).Milliseconds()\n386\t\n387\t\t// Download through Cloudflare (via err != nil {\n391\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to download canary: %w\", err)\n392\t\t}\n393\t\tdownloadedEnvelope, err := io.ReadAll(body)\n394\t\tbody.Close()\n395\t\tif err != nil Cloudflare cache status\n401\t\t// CF-Cache-Status values: HIT, MISS, EXPIRED, STALE, BYPASS, REVALIDATED, UPDATING, IGNORED\n402\t\tif cfStatus, ok := headers[\"CF-Cache-Status\"]; ok {\n403\t\t\tresult.CFCacheHit = (cfStatus == \"HIT\" || cfStatus == \"STALE\" || cfStatus == \"REVALIDATED\")\n404\t\t}\n405\t\n406\t\t// Parse header\n407\t\tdownloadedHeader, err := crypto.DecodeHeader(downloadedEnvelope)\n408\t\tif err != nil {\n409\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to decode header: %w\", err)\n410\t\t}\n411\t\n412\t\t// Extract encrypted blocks and HMAC table\n413\t\tdataStart := int64(crypto.HeaderSize)\n414\t\tdataEnd := dataStart + int64(len(canaryContent))\n415\t\thmacStart := downloadedHeader.HMACTableOffset()\n416\t\thmacEnd := hmacStart + int64(downloadedHeader.BlockCount())*crypto.HMACSize\n417\t\n418\t\tif hmacEnd > int64(len(downloadedEnvelope)) {\n419\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"downloaded envelope too short for HMAC table\")\n420\t\t}\n421\t\n422\t\tdownloadedEncrypted := downloadedEnvelope[dataStart:dataEnd]\n423\t\tdownloadedHMAC := downloadedEnvelope[hmacStart:hmacEnd]\n424\t\n425\t\t// Unwrap DEK\n426\t\tunwrappedDEK, err := crypto.UnwrapDEK(m.mek, wrappedDEK)\n427\t\tif err != nil {\n428\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to unwrap DEK: %w\", err)\n429\t\t}\n430\t\n431\t\t// Create err)\n435\t\t}\n436\t\n437\t\t// Verify HMACs\n438\t\tif err := decryptor.VerifyHMACs(downloadedEncrypted, downloadedHMAC); err != nil {\n439\t\t\tresult.HMACVerified = false\n440\t\t\treturn nil, downloadedHMAC)\n446\t\tif err != nil {\n447\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to decrypt: %w\", err)\n448\t\t}\n449\t\n450\t\t// Verify decrypted content matches original\n451\t\tif !bytes.Equal(decrypted, canaryContent) {\n452\t\t\tresult.DecryptVerified = false\n453\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"decrypted content does not match original\")\n454\t\t}\n455\t\tresult.DecryptVerified = true\n456\t\n457\t\t// Verify plaintext SHA\n458\t\tif err := downloadedHeader.VerifyPlaintextSHA(decrypted); err != nil {\n459\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"plaintext SHA verification failed: %w\", err)\n460\t\t}\n461\t\n462\t\t// Clean up canary (best effort)\n463\t\tgo func() {\n464\t\t\tcleanupCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)\n465\t\t\tdefer cancel()\n466\t\t\tm.backend.Delete(cleanupCtx, m.bucket, key)\n467\t\t}()\n468\t\n469\t\tresult.Status = StatusHealthy\n470\t\n471\t\treturn result, nil\n472\t}\n473\t\n474\t// b2MinPartSize is the minimum size B2 (via its S3-compatible API) accepts for\n475\t// any non-final multipart part. Uploading a smaller non-final part makes\n476\t// CompleteMultipartUpload fail with HTTP 400 EntityTooSmall (\"Your proposed\n477\t// upload is smaller than the minimum allowed size\"). The final part has no\n478\t// minimum.\n479\tconst b2MinPartSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024 // 5 MiB\n480\t\n481\t// canaryMultipartPartSize returns the size to use for each non-final part of the\n482\t// multipart canary, chosen to satisfy two constraints:\n483\t//   - at least b2MinPartSize (5 MiB), so B2 does not reject the non-final parts,\n484\t//     and\n485\t//   - a multiple of the encryption block size, so a part boundary never splits\n486\t//     an encryption block (ARMOR's CTR counter derivation requires block-aligned\n487\t//     parts).\n488\t//\n489\t// We target 5.25 MiB and round up to a block multiple; for the default 64 KiB\n490\t// block this is exactly 84 * 64 KiB = 5.25 MiB, comfortably above the 5 MiB\n491\t// floor.\n492\tfunc canaryMultipartPartSize(blockSize int) int {\n493\t\tif blockSize <= 0 {\n494\t\t\tblockSize = crypto.DefaultBlockSize\n495\t\t}\n496\t\tconst targetPartSize = 5505024 // 5.25 MiB\n497\t\tpartSize := ((targetPartSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize) * blockSize\n498\t\tif partSize < b2MinPartSize {\n499\t\t\t// Defensive: never round below the B2 minimum.\n500\t\t\tpartSize = ((b2MinPartSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize) * blockSize\n501\t\t}\n502\t\treturn partSize\n503\t}\n504\t\n505\t// checkMultipart performs a multipart canary check to exercise the multipart upload path.\n506\tfunc (m *Monitor) checkMultipart(ctx context.Context) (*Result, error) {\n507\t\tresult := &Result{\n508\t\t\tLastCheck: time.Now(),\n509\t\t}\n510\t\n511\t\t// Generate unique canary content with timestamp\n512\t\ttimestamp := time.Now().UnixNano()\n513\t\tcanaryContent := make([]byte, m.multipartSize)\n514\t\tif _, err := rand.Read(canaryContent); err != nil {\n515\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to generate multipart canary content: %w\", err)\n516\t\t}\n517\t\n518\t\t// Embed timestamp for verification\n519\t\tbinary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(canaryContent[:8], uint64(timestamp))\n520\t\n521\t\t// Generate unique key for this canary\n522\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\".armor/canary-multipart/%s/%d\", m.instanceID, timestamp)\n523\t\n524\t\t// Generate DEK and IV\n525\t\tdek, err := crypto.GenerateDEK()\n526\t\tif err != nil {\n527\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to generate DEK: %w\", err)\n528\t\t}\n529\t\n530\t\tiv, err := crypto.GenerateIV()\n531\t\tif err != nil {\n532\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to generate IV: %w\", err)\n533\t\t}\n534\t\n535\t\t// Wrap DEK with MEK\n536\t\twrappedDEK, err := crypto.WrapDEK(m.mek, dek)\n537\t\tif err != nil {\n538\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to wrap DEK: %w\", err)\n539\t\t}\n540\t\n541\t\t// Compute plaintext SHA-256\n542\t\tplaintextSHA := crypto.ComputePlaintextSHA256(canaryContent)\n543\t\n544\t\t// Create envelope header\n545\t\theader, err := crypto.NewEnvelopeHeader(iv, int64(len(canaryContent)), m.blockSize, plaintextSHA)\n546\t\tif err != nil {\n547\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create header: %w\", err)\n548\t\t}\n549\t\n550\t\theaderBytes, err := header.Encode()\n551\t\tif err != nil {\n552\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to encode header: %w\", err)\n553\t\t}\n554\t\n555\t\t// Encrypt\n556\t\tencryptor, err := crypto.NewEncryptor(dek, iv, m.blockSize)\n557\t\tif err != nil {\n558\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create encryptor: %w\", err)\n559\t\t}\n560\t\n561\t\tencrypted, hmacTable, err := encryptor.Encrypt(canaryContent)\n562\t\tif err != nil {\n563\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to encrypt: %w\", err)\n564\t\t}\n565\t\n566\t\t// Build envelope\n567\t\tenvelope := make([]byte, 0, len(headerBytes)+len(encrypted)+len(hmacTable))\n568\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, headerBytes...)\n569\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, encrypted...)\n570\t\tenvelope = append(envelope, hmacTable...)\n571\t\n572\t\t// Compute ETag\n573\t\tetag := backend.ComputeETag(canaryContent)\n574\t\n575\t\t// Build metadata\n576\t\tmeta := (&backend.ARMORMetadata{\n577\t\t\tVersion:       1,\n578\t\t\tBlockSize:     m.blockSize,\n579\t\t\tPlaintextSize: int64(len(canaryContent)),\n580\t\t\tContentType:   \"application/octet-stream\",\n581\t\t\tIV:            iv,\n582\t\t\tWrappedDEK:    wrappedDEK,\n583\t\t\tPlaintextSHA:  hex.EncodeToString(plaintextSHA[:]),\n584\t\t\tETag:          etag,\n585\t\t}).ToMetadata()\n586\t\n587\t\t// Upload via multipart API (exercises create/upload/complete path)\n588\t\tuploadStart := time.Now()\n589\t\n590\t\t// Step 1: Create multipart upload\n591\t\tuploadID, err := m.backend.CreateMultipartUpload(ctx, m.bucket, key, meta)\n592\t\tif err != nil {\n593\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create multipart upload: %w\", err)\n594\t\t}\n595\t\n596\t\t// Step 2: Upload parts CONCURRENTLY (ADR-005 + its 2026-07-19 amendment make\n597\t\t// out-of-order / concurrent part uploads a supported, first-class path). The\n598\t\t// canary must exercise that path continuously — not only the sequential one —\n599\t\t// so a regression that re-introduces ordering assumptions fails the canary\n600\t\t// loudly. Each part is a stateless per-part S3 call addressed by part number,\n601\t\t// so uploads are independent; goroutines complete in nondeterministic\n602\t\t// (\"shuffled\") order and the ETags are reassembled in ascending part-number\n603\t\t// order below, as CompleteMultipartUpload requires.\n604\t\t//\n605\t\t// B2 still rejects CompleteMultipartUpload with EntityTooSmall when any\n606\t\t// non-final part is smaller than 5 MiB, so each part except the last is at\n607\t\t// least b2MinPartSize and a multiple of the block size so a part boundary\n608\t\t// never splits an encryption block. For the default 64 KiB block this is\n609\t\t// 5.25 MiB (84 blocks).\n610\t\tpartSize := canaryMultipartPartSize(m.blockSize)\n611\t\n612\t\t// Pre-compute the disjoint part slices so each goroutine reads its own range\n613\t\t// of the envelope with no shared cursor. (partData aliases envelope, which is\n614\t\t// never mutated after this point, so concurrent reads are safe.)\n615\t\ttype canaryPart struct {\n616\t\t\tnum  int32\n617\t\t\tdata []byte\n618\t\t}\n619\t\tvar canaryParts []canaryPart\n620\t\tpartNum := int32(1)\n621\t\tfor offset := 0; offset < len(envelope); offset += partSize {\n622\t\t\tend := offset + partSize\n623\t\t\tif end > len(envelope) {\n624\t\t\t\tend = len(envelope)\n625\t\t\t}\n626\t\t\tcanaryParts = append(canaryParts, canaryPart{\n627\t\t\t\tnum:  partNum,\n628\t\t\t\tdata: envelope[offset:end],\n629\t\t\t})\n630\t\t\tpartNum++\n631\t\t}\n632\t\n633\t\t// ETags indexed by part number (position num-1); each goroutine writes a\n634\t\t// distinct slot, so no synchronization is needed on the slice itself.\n635\t\tpartETags := make([]string, len(canaryParts))\n636\t\tg, gctx := errgroup.WithContext(ctx)\n637\t\tfor _, cp := range canaryParts {\n638\t\t\tcp := cp // captured per-goroutine\n639\t\t\tg.Go(func() error {\n640\t\t\t\tetag, err := m.backend.UploadPart(gctx, m.bucket, key, uploadID, cp.num, bytes.NewReader(cp.data),
